summary: Implemented the issue #201 refactor. Event handlers are now split into a plain core layer and thin ignite wrappers. New files: monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver), monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver), monai/visualize/visualizer.py (plot_2d_or_3d_image). Refactored: monai/handlers/segmentation_saver.py and classification_saver.py now delegate to those classes, keeping their public signatures. monai/handlers/tensorboard_handlers.py delegates image plotting to plot_2d_or_3d_image. Added unit tests: tests/test_nifti_saver.py, test_csv_saver.py, test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py, test_segmentation_saver.py. Updated docs/source/data.rst and visualize.rst. Nothing was committed. Tests were NOT run, per instructions, so the changes are verified by reading only. A known pre-existing quirk in the 3D non-RGB path of the image plotter (it returns after the first channel) was preserved and is flagged for a decision.
